COMPUTER STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.

2. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Data communication.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication.

3. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer storage.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer storage.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer storage.

4. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Data communication 2.2 Data Transmission Media 2.3 Computer Network Elements 2.4.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

8. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Operating System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Operating System.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.

11. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati.

12. When learning Computer Organisation and Architecture, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Organisation and Architecture.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Organisation and Architecture.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Program Development Overview and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Identifiers and Operators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Control Structures 3.5 Data Structures 3.6 Functions Page 15 of 72 1 STRAND 1.0: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Control Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
